name: COUNTERTOP ALKALINE WATER MACHINE
summary: The ZeroB Alkaline RO Water Purifier features a 10 LPH purification capacity , 8-litre storage tank , and an advanced RO + ESS purification system with alkaline ionization technology.
intro: The ZeroB Alkaline RO Water Purifier is a high-performance water purification system designed to provide safe, healthy, and mineral-rich drinking water. It features an advanced RO + ESS (Electrolytic Sanitizing System) purification process with an 11-plate platinum-coated titanium ionizer that enhances water by increasing its alkalinity while retaining essential minerals. The purifier includes an 8-litre storage tank, 3.8-inch colour LCD display, and a 10 LPH purification capacity, making it ideal for homes and small offices. Suitable for municipal and borewell water with TDS up to 1500 ppm, it ensures reliable purification and superior water quality. Residential homes and small offices using municipal or borewell water within the specified water quality limits.
